name: Modal
summary: Dialog overlay with backdrop, dialog container, header, title, body, footer, open state, motion, and accessibility behavior requirements.

anatomy.name: overlay
anatomy.description: Backdrop layer that controls visibility and centers the dialog.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Dialog container that owns surface, radius, shadow, scrolling, and entrance motion.

anatomy.name: header
anatomy.description: Optional top region for title and close affordance.

anatomy.name: title
anatomy.description: Optional modal title used by aria-labelledby.

anatomy.name: body
anatomy.description: Primary content region inside the dialog.

anatomy.name: footer
anatomy.description: Optional action region, usually containing button components.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Default modal width and viewport bounds.

states.name: open
states.description: Visible overlay state controlled by aria-hidden="false".

states.name: entered
states.description: Dialog transform state after the overlay is open.

behavior.name: visibility
behavior.description: The overlay is hidden by default and becomes visible when aria-hidden is set to false.

behavior.name: dialogSemantics
behavior.description: The dialog container must expose modal semantics and a programmatic name.

behavior.name: focusManagement
behavior.description: Opening the modal moves focus inside it, traps tab navigation while open, and restores focus to the trigger on close.

behavior.name: dismissal
behavior.description: The modal must provide at least one visible close mechanism and should close on Escape.

properties.name: open
properties.description: Controls whether the modal overlay is visible. Consumer targets still own focus management and dismissal behavior.

accessibility: Set aria-hidden="false" on the overlay when open and aria-hidden="true" when closed.
Use role="dialog" and aria-modal="true" on the modal container.
Provide a programmatic name with aria-labelledby or aria-label.
Trap keyboard focus inside the modal while it is open.
Return focus to the trigger element when the modal closes.
Close on Escape and provide a visible close or cancel action.

web.notes: Implemented by class composition in components/css/layout.css; behavior must be provided by the consuming target.

shopify.notes: Shopify Liquid can render modal structure while theme JavaScript controls visibility and focus behavior.
